title: PowerToys Monaco Preview Handler displays UTF-16LE .reg files with NUL characters

status.label: Current-version encoding bug
status.detail: The reporter confirmed the UTF-16LE preview failure after manually updating to 0.101.2362.

next_action.label: Design encoding-detection fix
next_action.reason: The file type, encoding, comparison handler, and current-version result are all documented.

actions.label: Design Monaco UTF-16LE preview fix
actions.note: Trace Monaco Preview Handler text decoding for registry files and define UTF-16LE/UTF-8 regression fixtures. This drafts no upstream mutation.

judgment.rationale: The issue supplies a deterministic encoding comparison and a current-release confirmation, removing the earlier version uncertainty.
evidence: Registry Editor saves the affected .reg files as UTF-16LE.
Monaco Preview Handler renders NUL markers between characters, while the same content saved as UTF-8 previews correctly.
The reporter manually updated to 0.101.2362 and confirmed the issue still reproduces; the built-in Windows text preview handles the UTF-16LE file correctly.
judgment.recommended_action: Investigate Monaco Preview Handler encoding detection and design tests using representative UTF-16LE registry files.
